notes.title: Official Release Update! Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Official Release Update![/b][/h1]

These are basically all the things that I wanted to release in the first version of the game but was not able to release yet!

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Auto-save function!
[*] More efficient GPU usage!
[*] Mac version!
[/list]
